verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party capability for users to set up autonomous background automations. The MCP server and the Ava assistant answer on-demand natural-language queries. Navan Edge explicitly requires confirmation before acting. The API, webhooks, scheduled partner integrations and policy/approval workflows are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not user-configurable autonomous automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
